memory.title: Tally money is Decimal end to end
memory.body: All amounts are Decimal in the order's currency. money.to_decimal refuses floats on purpose; build test values with Decimal("12.50").

memory.title: rules.py tables are read as rules.NAME
memory.body: tally/pricing.py does `from tally import rules` and reads `rules.DISCOUNT_CODES` etc. at call time, so adding a table to rules.py needs no import change in pricing.py, and tests can patch a table in place.

memory.title: Totals is built with keywords; new fields need defaults
memory.body: order_total builds Totals with keyword arguments, but callers outside tally construct Totals positionally with the five original fields. Append new fields at the end with a default.

decisions.title: Round each component once, never the running total
decisions.decision: line_total, the discount, shipping and tax are each rounded with round_money when computed; order_total only adds rounded components.
decisions.rationale: Invoices must add up line by line; rounding the running total produced one-cent mismatches.

decisions.title: Fees are flat per currency, not converted
decisions.decision: Any flat fee is a per-currency table in tally/rules.py keyed by ISO code; there is no FX conversion in tally.
decisions.rationale: Finance sets local prices per market.
alternatives: one USD fee converted at a daily rate

notices.summary: Discount codes are now matched case-insensitively (apply_discount uppercases the code).
